facts.text: Report holder ACME PANEL COMPANY; subject is structural insulated panels.
SIPs are roof, floor and wall panels, combustible for construction type under IBC Chapter 6, and may be used as fire-resistance-rated assemblies per §4.3.1-4.3.3.

§4.3.1 describes a one-hour limited load-bearing wall assembly using SIPs of 4 5/8, 6 1/2 or 8 1/4 inches (114, 165 or 210 mm), with the core recessed from the panel edges; further one-hour assemblies are described on p5.
A footnote states that axial-load limitations in §4.3 must be observed for fire-resistance-rated wall assemblies.
Installation per the report and manufacturer instructions; thicknesses listed only; no span extrapolation; shear walls in SDC D-F need sealed lateral-load calculations.
Evidence listed: AC04 (June 2019, editorially revised December 2020); ASTM E455; cyclic shear per AC04 Appendix A; ASTM E119; NFPA 286.
Label must show ESR-4690 and ACME Panel Company.
